- V97Recalculate:
    Control: ModernText@1.0.0
    Properties:
      Text: =""
      X: =0
      Y: =0
      Width: =1
      Height: =1
      Font: =Font.Arial
      Size: =10
      Color: =RGBA(219,227,238,1)
      Align: =Align.Right
      VerticalAlign: =VerticalAlign.Middle
      Fill: =RGBA(0,0,0,0)
      Visible: =false
      PaddingLeft: =6
      PaddingRight: =6
      Wrap: =true
      OnSelect: |-
        =ClearCollect(colV97Rows,ForAll(colV97Base As r,Patch(r,{Current:If(IsBlank(r.Base),Blank(),r.Base+Sum(Filter(colV97Effects,Target=r.RowId) As w,w.Weight*(Sum(Filter(colV97Entries,Debit=w.Source),Amount)-Sum(Filter(colV97Entries,Credit=w.Source),Amount))))})));
        Set(varV97NetDelta,-Sum(Filter(colV97Rows,RowId="pnl_r289"),Current-Base));
        Set(varV97OpCash,Sum(Filter(colV97Entries,Flow="operating"),CashDelta));
        Set(varV97InvCash,Sum(Filter(colV97Entries,Flow="investing"),CashDelta));
        Set(varV97FinCash,Sum(Filter(colV97Entries,Flow="financing"),CashDelta));
        UpdateIf(colV97Rows,RowId="cf_net_profit",{Current:Base+varV97NetDelta});
        UpdateIf(colV97Rows,RowId="cf_adjustments",{Current:Base+varV97OpCash-varV97NetDelta});
        UpdateIf(colV97Rows,RowId="cf_op_total" || RowId="cf_op_header",{Current:Base+varV97OpCash});
        UpdateIf(colV97Rows,RowId="cf_inv_total" || RowId="cf_inv_header",{Current:Base+varV97InvCash});
        UpdateIf(colV97Rows,RowId="cf_fin_total" || RowId="cf_fin_header",{Current:Base+varV97FinCash});
        UpdateIf(colV97Rows,RowId="cf_change" || RowId="cf_close",{Current:Base+varV97OpCash+varV97InvCash+varV97FinCash});
        If(varV97InvCash<>0,Collect(colV97Rows,Patch(LookUp(colV97Base,RowId="cf_inv_total"),{RowId:"cf_manual_inv",Name:"השפעת פקודות ידניות",Kind:"item",Base:0,Prior:0,Current:varV97InvCash,Order:LookUp(colV97Base,RowId="cf_inv_total",Order)-0.5,Depth:1})));
